corpus.content: The checkout service runs on port 8080 with 6 workers.
The media service was moved to the new cluster on 2024-06-01.

checks.query: what runs on port 8080, and where does the media service run?

corrections: Port 8080 belongs only to the checkout service. The media service has no port-8080 binding.
Correction: it is false that the media service runs on port 8080.
